profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer - Human Resources at AT&T
profile.summary:
Programming Languages: C#, Java, VB.NET, C++, Python, Angular, Javascript, HTML, CSS, PHP

Technologies: SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle, Apache Web Server, IIS, CENTOS, VOIP, Asterisk, FreePBX, ServiceNow, SOAP, Web Services, XML, Cisco Router IOS, VMWARE, Virtual PC, Mac OS X, AWS, APIs

RPA Tools: Blue Prism, Automation Anywhere, UI Path

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained HR applications using Java and Angular.

Migrated web data for proof-of-concept project using ServiceNow.

Trained in ServiceNow development.

positions.title: Professional Software Engineer - Human Resources
positions.description:
Led the development and deployment of a RPA platform (Blue Prism) to support hundreds of concurrent bots.

Designed and implemented RESTful APIs for chatbot integration.

Created reusable developer APIs using C#.

positions.title: Business Owner/Developer
positions.description:
Develop apps for both iPhone and Android. 

Developed the TubeSquare app that is currently published on the iTunes’ AppStore and recently for Android market. This app lets user watch their kids, home, and business with just a computer webcam or two for FREE, or a paid version that connects up to 6 Wired/Wireless IP Cameras. With the ability to share and live stream to any device and/or any OSes. Built-in Text 2 Speech that automatically recognizes up to 11 languages and the selected computer will speak on the remote end.

Published free and paid version of the app called PhotoMinder on the Android Market, this app snaps a picture in time to bring you back to the same location later or use it to research for nearby places such as real estate prices, restaurants, places, etc.

Developed WiMotely a desktop peer-to-peer multimedia sharing program that was registered as one of the applications in the INTEL Developer contest.

positions.title: Professional - Applications Developer
positions.description:
Pioneered the development of an Automation Anywhere RESTful API, enabling efficient bot farm management.

Developed a mobile application for Android devices to automate set-top box equipment activation.

Administered and maintained legacy applications built in various languages.

positions.title: SBC Careers
positions.description: Developed a widely used desktop application (FAME) for accessing enterprise mainframes.

positions.title: Order Router And Control
positions.description: Processed orders in IBM OS400/mainframe 9000 systems, setup truck delivery routes, worked with customer care center and billing reconcilation department. Trained new employee and manager on OS400/9000 systems from different job sites and centers annually.
